sammendrag: Multiply is a national programme designed to improve adult numeracy as part of the UK Shared Prosperity Fund. This trial will test the impact of delivering maths aligned to Key Stage 1 Year 2, and Functional Skills Maths Level 1, to parents in primary school settings. Parents will be motivated to take part by being better able to support their child’s maths learning. Through taking part, parents will increase their own maths confidence and willingness and interest to progress to more formal maths provision.
tittel: The impact of whole family maths courses on parents’ progression to further maths courses – a two-armed cluster randomised controlled trial
